notes.title: Big Update (New Game Mode)
notes.content:
[b]Major Update Is Live – New Weapons, Maps, and More![/b]

[h1]What's New:[/h1]
[list]
[*] 3 new types of weapons added – You no longer have to run, you can fight back!
[*] 2 new maps to explore
[*] Save system implemented
[*] Score system added
[*] Global leaderboard – See the top 10 monster hunters!
[*] Character customization – Choose your character color
[*] New types of monsters introduced
[*] New obstacles placed in maps
[*] New damage system
[*] Enemy spawn system added
[*] Inventory system improved
[/list]


[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] In-game voice chat issues resolved
[*] Improved AI behavior
[*] Fixed collision problems in some maps
[*] Improved interaction system
[*] Death-related bugs fixed
[*] Fixed AI sound bugs
[*] Fixed issues with the end screen
[/list]

notes.title: 📢 Demo Update is Live!
notes.content:
Hello explorers,  

We've taken your feedback into account and made our demo more immersive and exciting! Here are the key improvements in this update:  

- [b]Enhanced Atmosphere:[/b] We have reworked the lighting and sound design to create a more intense and immersive experience.  
- [b]New Enemy AI:[/b]Smarter and more terrifying entities have been added. Surviving just got even harder!  
- [b]Improved Interactions:[/b] In-game interactions are now more realistic, pulling you deeper into the experience.  
- [b]Bug Fixes & Lobby Overhaul:[/b] We've fixed many bugs and revamped the lobby system for a smoother gameplay experience.  

[b]The demo is now smoother, scarier, and more immersive than ever!
Jump back in and face the new threats! **Play now and share your feedback with us![/b]

[b]Stay tuned for an even better Backrooms experience![/b]
